brief:
Rescue operations concluded Thursday in the rubble of a bomb-damaged building that collapsed in Gaza, where 21 people were killed and 45 others were pulled from the debris, Al-Monitor reported. The structure's failure came a day before the search wrapped up.

The building had sustained prior bomb damage before giving way, leaving rescue workers to extract survivors and recover bodies from the wreckage over the course of the operation.

title: Twenty-one die in Gaza building collapse; rescuers end search
